verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community indexing tip about disabling the refresh interval during bulk indexing, which implies Elasticsearch supports bulk ingestion of many documents at once. The first-party docs in the pack never describe a bulk API or batch update/delete operations, so support is only glancingly evidenced. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a bulk API, batch update/delete-by-query operations, evidence of agent/AI-native bulk workflows (e.g., via MCP or clients), and hands-on corroboration.
